title: Headway Appointment Copay Leaderboard
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=headway:appointment copay_usd=*
| stats sum(copay_usd) as total_value, avg(copay_usd) as avg_value by provider_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks provider values by total and average copay across Headway appointment events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `copay_usd` values for each Headway appointment event and review total and average copay by provider.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total copay.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which provider shows the biggest copay numbers in your Headway appointment data.
